[.quick-access-title]
Quick access

[.quick-access-grid]
* [.qa-badge]#HTML# xref:developers:specification.adoc[Specification {page-component-version} online]

* [.qa-badge]#DOCX# xref:ROOT:attachment${spec-basename}.docx[Download as Word]
* [.qa-badge]#JSON# xref:developers:schema.adoc[Schema reference]
* [.qa-badge]#START# xref:users:getting-started.adoc[Getting started]
* [.qa-badge]#TSV# xref:users:examples.adoc[Example files]
* [.qa-badge]#CHECK# xref:validation:index.adoc[Validate a file]
* [.qa-badge]#CITE# xref:about:cite.adoc[How to cite]
